meta.name: general-video
meta.description: Author or edit a custom HyperFrames composition when no specialized workflow fits, or when BRIEF.md sets flow: companion. Use for longer or multi-scene pieces, brand and sizzle reels, montages, static loops, static title cards, footage remixes, and freeform builds. Use motion-graphics instead for a short unnarrated motion-first unit, including an animated title. Route fresh creation through hyperframes before using this skill.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把素材和想法剪成品牌宣传片、混剪、蒙太奇或多场景定制视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要制作多场景的定制视频,而现成模板覆盖不了你的需求
copy.tagline_en: Turn footage and ideas into brand reels, montages, or multi-scene custom videos
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a multi-scene custom video that templates can't cover

howto.what: 当没有专门工作流匹配时,Claude 会用 HyperFrames 编排或编辑通用视频合成:长片、多场景、品牌与宣传片、蒙太奇、静态循环、静态标题卡、素材混剪等。它会先把命名的效果放到线上目录里搜一遍,再动手规划场景。
howto.when: 当没有专门工作流匹配,或 BRIEF.md 里写 flow: companion 时由它接管;新建视频要先经 hyperframes 路由过来。

say.text: 用 general-video 做一个 30 秒三段场景的品牌宣传片。
say.note: 它会先搜目录,再规划各场景。

say.text: 把这两段素材剪成蒙太奇,保留原声。
say.note: 它复制视频源并设好时间区间。

say.text: 只改第 2 个场景的转场,其他别动。
say.note: 它做完这一处修改再重跑相关检查。

howto.what_en: When no specialized workflow fits, Claude authors or edits a general HyperFrames composition: multi-scene pieces, brand and sizzle reels, montages, static loops, title cards, footage remixes. It searches the hosted catalog before hand-building a named look.
howto.when_en: Triggers when no specialized workflow fits, or when BRIEF.md sets flow: companion. Fresh creation routes through hyperframes first.

say_en.text: Make a 30-second brand reel with three scenes using general-video.
say_en.note: It searches the catalog, then plans scenes.

say_en.text: Cut these two clips into a montage and keep the original audio.
say_en.note: It duplicates the source and sets clip ranges.

say_en.text: Change scene 2's transition, leave everything else alone.
say_en.note: It edits, then reruns affected checks.
